title: NEB Class 11 Mathematics — Trigonometry — 2020
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question:
Prove that
$$\cos\theta+\cos3\theta+\cos5\theta+\cdots+\cos(2n-1)\theta=\frac{\sin2n\theta}{2\sin\theta}$$
questions.solution:
Multiply both sides by $2\sin\theta$ and use $2\sin A\cos B=\sin(A+B)+\sin(A-B)$:

$$2\sin\theta\cos\theta=\sin2\theta$$
$$2\sin\theta\cos3\theta=\sin4\theta-\sin2\theta$$
$$2\sin\theta\cos5\theta=\sin6\theta-\sin4\theta$$
$$\vdots$$
$$2\sin\theta\cos(2n-1)\theta=\sin2n\theta-\sin(2n-2)\theta$$

Adding all these equations, every intermediate term cancels in pairs:
$$2\sin\theta\left[\cos\theta+\cos3\theta+\cos5\theta+\cdots+\cos(2n-1)\theta\right]=\sin2n\theta$$
Dividing by $2\sin\theta$:
$$\cos\theta+\cos3\theta+\cdots+\cos(2n-1)\theta=\frac{\sin2n\theta}{2\sin\theta}$$
which is the required result.
questions.knowledgeNote: Multiply an odd cosine series by $2\sin\theta$: the terms telescope to $\sin2n\theta$.
